why: embeddings.npz/embeddings.json and the nomic embedder (Ollama) live on the PC; this build ran on the VM under the stage's no-PC-access boundary.
finalize: tools/finalize_vectors.py, run where the embeddings file and Ollama live: joins vector rows to chunks by sha1(text); vector-file chunk texts are canonical for mismatched URLs (they replace the replica chunks for those docs, marked origin='vector_file'); chunks of missing URLs are embedded with nomic-embed-text and appended; orphan rows are dropped; synthetic-question vectors are embedded into synthq_vectors; the result must satisfy exact consistency (every chunk has exactly one vector row) before meta.vectors_state flips to 'ready'.
